name: Converter
descriptor: One amount, two units, a factor table. Nothing is stored, because a conversion is not a record.
verify_checks: convert: the conversion function is emitted
convert: the unit table reached the model
pros: the factor table is data, so a new dimension is a new spec
no storage and no history: nothing to lose, nothing to clear
two selects and one number, so it is usable one-handed
exact factors in the spec, not rounded constants in code
cons: one dimension per app; temperature needs an offset, which this does not do
no history, so a conversion cannot be revisited
the factors are as good as whoever typed them
it will not tell you which unit is sensible
best_for: one family of units, converted often
avoid_if: the conversion needs an offset (temperature), or several dimensions at once
